scope: Accelerate the unchanged 476-request final GPU serving schedule using all eight physical GPUs.
cohorts: Selected model/seed batch-1 stays on its original GPU. Its entire batch-8 cohort, including source, independent controls and every selected method, is repeated on a registered spare GPU. Publish only that entire new batch-8 cohort; retain original-card results as diagnostics.
selection: Choose two longest remaining 4B model lanes by frozen request counts, without using latency or quality outcomes.
preflight: Two real batch-8 requests on each new card; source/native cached logits and generated IDs must match byte for byte before timings.
isolation: One timing worker per physical GPU, disjoint CPU sets including SMT siblings. Preserve all active workers; routing begins before CUDA initialization. Host memory bandwidth remains shared.
retention: Never overwrite a completed original sample. Archive original, spare and effective controllers with hashes and full request coverage. No candidate, prompt or repetition is removed.
